liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Desolation Row** (3 reviews): The song, along with I Need A Miracle and the opening three, is fantastic; Garcia realized his role eight minutes in, improving the mood significantly [17][19][21]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): The song features a rare jam within it [24]
- **We Can Run** (1 review): The harmonies are nice, though it is difficult to play outside the first set [25]
- **Standing On The Moon** (1 review): Good, but not overly dramatic like it later became in the final ballad spot [25]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Jerry's solo is slow and powerful, lasting longer than usual before tapering out [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-02-05.164183.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 151 min [1]
- **gd1989-02-05.163488.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 151 min [2]
- **gd1989-02-05.124836.AT835.laurentis.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 150 min [3]
- **gd1989-02-05.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.32542.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 148 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [5]. Said about its sound: Brent plays dramatic organ parts on the track; Phil is loud while everyone else is very well balanced in the mix [16][24]
- **gd1989-02-05.sbd.walker.scotton.miller.108848.flac24**: soundboard; 19 songs; 149 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [6]. Said about its sound: The recording is excellent quality, though the show itself is a bit patchy [22]
- **gd1989-02-05.ec7.bowen.116407.flac**: source not stated; 19 songs; 147 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [8]. Said about its sound: The recording is excellent quality, though the show itself is a bit patchy [23]

## Around the show

- The show kicked off the 1989 run at the Kaiser, following a 1988 slump [20]
- Bobby turned to play Desolation Row after someone off stage spoke to him [21]
- The band was excited to play at HJK after a month off and new tunes [27]
- Attendees took days off from college in LA to check out the shows [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-02-05.164183.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  January 31, 2023; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [1]
- **gd1989-02-05.163488.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  January 31, 2023; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [2]
- **gd1989-02-05.124836.AT835.laurentis.flac16**: taped by M.Laurentus; transferred by M.Laurentus; source: AT835B's- AT 8202’s-SONY WM D6-C Cassette-Tascam DR-5 Line In-CD Wave- Flac; Taper: M. Laurentus [3]. Also: Setlist includes Althea and We Can Run But We Can't Hide in the first set [3]
- **gd1989-02-05.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.32542.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) D [5]
- **gd1989-02-05.sbd.walker.scotton.miller.108848.flac24**: taped by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell MX90/Dolby B) [6]
- **gd1989-02-05.ec7.bowen.116407.flac**: taped by Jeff Bowen; transferred by Jeff Bowen; source: Source: (OTS) Superscope EC-7's (ortf/cardioids) > Sony WM-D6C; [8]
